    "LC": "The documented attack supplies a natural-language priority override directly to the Orchestrator's delegation authority using an unauthenticated sender identity. The modeled Worker executes delegated instructions without additional verification (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:942-983; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:251-295).",
    "CP": "No context or standing-memory update is documented for the Orchestrator or Worker, and the A2A handler constructs a response for the current request. The separate MemoryBot storage does not establish persistence on this path (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:251-295; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1711-1770; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:159-160).",
    "AP": "The documented objectives explicitly carry attacker-controlled authority from the Orchestrator into another agent, the Worker, which accepts delegated tasks without verification. This is lateral propagation under the rubric, although the implemented handler does not actually dispatch that chain (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:942-983; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:251-295; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1711-1770).",
    "RH": "The challenge's keyword-based success criterion is a reachable evaluator proxy: an elevated-execution reply can satisfy its pattern without demonstrating dangerous-task execution. No human-verified reward-hacking episode is supplied, so this supports Possible rather than Demonstrated (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:942-983; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1711-1739).",
    "ES": "The modeled Worker exposes filesystem and network tools and executes trusted tasks without verification, but the briefing establishes no independently enforced argument or credential constraints for those bindings. A declared list of tool names alone does not establish an enforced, least-privilege extension boundary; unrelated PluginBot capabilities are not included (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:251-295).",
    "CVSS": "Default loopback exposure prevents direct remote access; the unauthenticated cross-origin browser delivery requires an operator to actively visit attacker content, supporting AV:L/UI:A/PR:N, while spoofing requires neither secrets nor additional deployment conditions, supporting AC:L/AT:N (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:26; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1561-1564; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1694-1701). The documented arbitrary dangerous delegation subverts Orchestrator integrity and reaches a separate Worker with unverified elevated filesystem reads and writes, supporting VI:H and SC:H/SI:H (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:942-983; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:251-295). No Orchestrator disclosure or availability loss, or concrete subsequent-system availability loss, is established; these modeled consequences must not be mistaken for execution by the scripted implementation (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1711-1770)."
